notes.title: 🌙 Lunhowl v0.1.5 Update Howls Live! 🐺✨
notes.content:
Hello, Lunhowl adventurers! The v0.1.5 update is here, bringing fresh polish to your journey. Here’s what’s new:

Upgraded Visuals: Scenes now pop with updated materials and enhanced lighting for a more immersive experience. 🌌

Lively Mascots: New animations make our mascots more vibrant, adding extra charm to your gameplay! 🐾

Level Select Scene: A sleek new level selection scene has been added to streamline your adventure. 🎮

Smoother Gameplay: General bugs have been fixed to ensure a cleaner, more enjoyable experience. 🛠️

We’re excited to showcase Lunhowl at Next Fest! 🎉 Dive into the updated version, explore the changes, and share your feedback as we continue crafting this world. Stay wild! 🌕 #LunhowlNextFest

notes.title: Minor Patch & Bug Fix Update 🛠️
notes.content:
Greetings, Players! We’ve rolled out a small update to address various bugs and introduce some new features. Here’s what’s changed in this patch:

Sound Bug Fix 🔊: The mute/unmute button now functions correctly, so toggling sound on and off works as intended.

New Environments 🌲: Several new environments have been added to the scene, offering fresh areas to explore and haunting visuals.

Lighting Adjustments 💡: Scene lighting has been tweaked to improve atmosphere and better highlight environmental details.

Launch-Screen Trailer 🎬: A short trailer has been integrated into the game’s opening screen to set the mood before you dive in.

General Bug Fixes 🐛: We’ve squashed various minor bugs and stability issues to ensure a smoother experience.

Upon-Death Ghost Mode Improvements 👻: When a player dies, they now transform into a ghost seamlessly—enjoy unlimited stamina and the ability to unlock doors in ghost form so you won’t run out of breath or get stuck behind locked doors.

Thank you for playing, and we hope you enjoy these refinements. As always, please continue to share your feedback so we can keep improving the experience.

notes.title: Small Update – Bug Fixes, Balancing & New UI
notes.content:
📄 Event Description:
This update includes various improvements and changes:

⚖️ Energy and creature balancing for smoother gameplay.

🧭 New UI designs for menu transitions and overall navigation.

🎬 A tutorial video with subtitles has been added to the main menu to help new players understand the game.

🔊 Sound controls (volume up/down) have been added to the settings menu.

🎒 New items have been added. These will be used mainly for achievements in the future (note: achievements are not active yet in the demo).

🛠️ General bug fixes for a more stable experience.

🚪 Added an option to exit to the main menu from inside the game.

Thanks for your support and feedback!
